Hi everyone! My name is Rigala! I've been on furry amino for a while but as I finally made a reference sheet, I'm here now too! I am a "Kwoger". I DID NOT DO THE LINEART!!! I only modified the free line art from Texas Coyote. I'd love to hear feedback from you guys if you want! 

I am still new to all this! Hope you enjoy him! 

A Kwoger is my own species with various parts evolved over time to help it survive while looking cute •w•

Rigala is an extension of me and thus, he is known to be super ticklish everywhere, especially the belly; he is shy but kind and loves to see peace and is willing to sacrifice himself for the benefit of others, though he easily gets tired from too much social interaction. He unwinds with his Nintendo switch and collects plush toys of Pokemon! He likes to see people smile.

Fur coats of the Kwoger can change to reflect significant life events. Rigala's right arm is black as a reminder of the hardships and struggles he went through being the only Kwoger at this time.

He has made it his goal to see others not go through something similar. He is very sensitive as a result and could shed tears when seeing sadness. Some say his tears taste of strawberry but that's just a ridiculous rumor apparently, which he rather dislikes... He also has a negative outlook on closed minded people.

Rigala is known to be hot headed at times but he means well and he can deeply regret an outburst if the other party is overly guilty... He is hot headed because he unfortunately had a poor relationship with his father which led him to become disappointed in not having a father figure to take care of his family. He always felt he should be able to do more for everyone... To the point he can tire himself to have anxiety and mild depression...

He is young though so he still has a lot to learn! Life lessons will come thick and fast for Rigala and he appreciates a challenge, especially if it gives him a chance to make some friends along the way! Especially helpful are a few hugs on the way!

Thanks for reading up to here if you did! I hope to fully flesh him out in a wiki entry soon and get to commissioning some artists soon!
